summary: Recorded the local runtime boundary and framework entrypoint decisions.
decisions: The default local runtime boundary is run-owned Git worktree isolation.
Worktree isolation protects the source worktree but does not claim process, network, host, or secret isolation.
OCI containers, devcontainers, VMs, remote sandboxes, and secret brokers are deferred future adapters.
The default operation route is local Skill plus repository documentation.
The next operation implementation route is CLI plus Skill.
MCP is deprecated as a default starter route and should not receive new default-route features.
notes: TASK-0014 is the next focused implementation task for CLI plus Skill operation.
TASK-0010 now waits for TASK-0014 so ApprovalService uses the same default operation surface.
The producer did not mark TASK-0009 completed; independent verification remains required.
